column1: # The difficulty mod's moby classes: what it does with each (README.md, "Which mobys count as enemies").
# tools/gen_classes.py writes src/classes.h from this table and the SDK's behaviour catalogue
# (catalogue/rac1/classes.json); tests/classes_test.cpp checks that every catalogue class whose name
# says enemy, turret, mine, boss, ship or thief is here.
#   enemy     copied (Enemy count above 1), dropped (below 1), sped up or slowed, hit harder or softer
#   roamer    dropped, sped up or slowed, hit harder or softer; never copied (the reason says why)
#   turret    sped up or slowed (aim and fire rate), hit harder or softer; never copied or dropped
#   boss      hit harder or softer only
#   excluded  left as the game has it (the reason says why)
